results.snippet: Kazakhstan is preparing to join a test of digital documentation for freight shipments between China and the Eurasian Economic Union (EAEU). The first digitally documented shipments covering coal, fertilizers, and consumer goods have begun moving through the Grodekovo-Suifenhe border crossing in Northeast China and Russia’s Far East.
